slides.title: 9pm. Form sent.
slides.body: It lands in an inbox nobody checks until morning.

slides.title: 9am. Office opens.
slides.body: The tenant has probably moved on.

slides.kicker: Same form, with a system behind it
slides.title: 9pm. Reply in seconds.
slides.body: Which property? When can you view? How many people?

slides.kicker: Same form, with a system behind it
slides.title: Viewing booked.
slides.body: In the calendar. In the CRM. Your team sees it at 9am, done.

slides.title: No new website.
slides.body:
Just what happens after the form.

slides.title: A chatbot isn't a system.
slides.body: If it can't check the calendar, update the CRM and hand off to a human, it's a toy.

slides.title: The after-hours form.
slides.body: It works. Nobody answers until morning.

slides.title: The shared inbox.
slides.body: Everyone sees it. Nobody owns it.

slides.title: The slow first reply.
slides.body: A plain reply now beats a perfect one tomorrow.

slides.title: The reply with no next step.
slides.body: "Let us know what suits" is where it goes quiet.

slides.title: No follow-up.
slides.body:
One reply, then nothing.
